elements_not_encoded.text: If shock/SBP < 80, give sodium chloride 0.9% 500mL IV over 30 minutes, repeat until systolic BP > 80. Continue 1L 6 hourly. Stop if breathing worsens.
If meningitis likely, give ceftriaxone2 2g IM. Avoid injecting > 1g IM at one injection site. If referral delayed, repeat ceftriaxone2 2g IM after 12 hours.
If fingerprick glucose < 3 (< 4 if diabetes) or ≥ 11.1 19.
elements_not_encoded.reason: Glucose check routed to page 19 within the management list.

elements_not_encoded.text: If pain, give single dose paracetamol 1g orally.
